title: 1 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 1 Timothy 6: masters and servants, false teachers who think godliness is profit, the love of money, and the charge to the rich.

questions.text: What should bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says they should count their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the doctrine are not blasphemed.

questions.text: How is the person described who teaches a different doctrine and does not consent to sound words?
questions.explanation: Verses 3 and 4 say such a person is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes and word battles.

questions.text: What do the people of corrupt minds suppose that godliness is?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 describes people of corrupt minds, destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.

questions.text: Godliness with contentment is called what?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that godliness with contentment is great gain.

questions.text: With what does the text say we will be content?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

questions.text: According to verse 10, the love of money is a root of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and that some have been led astray from the faith in their greed.

questions.text: What is the man of God told to take hold of?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says to fight the good fight of faith and to take hold of the eternal life to which he was called.

questions.text: Before whom did Christ Jesus testify the good confession?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says that Christ Jesus testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate.

questions.text: Where are those who are rich in this present world told to set their hope?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 charges the rich not to be arrogant and not to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides everything to enjoy.

questions.text: What is Timothy told to turn away from while guarding what was committed to him?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 tells Timothy to guard what is committed to him and to turn away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge.

answers.text: Empty chatter and what is falsely called knowledge
Letters sent from the faraway cities of Asia
The company of his own believing masters
The teaching he received from the elders
